XenotypeDef.label: Digital Mind Nanoswarm
XenotypeDef.description: A digital mind nanoswarm is a cloud-like swarm of nanoscale robots, remotely controlled by a digitized human mind housed inside a Neural Projection Cabinet. While these nanoswarm bodies do not have standard nutritional or sleep needs, they do have to return regularly to the projection cabinet to replenish the nanoswarms population.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A digital mind nanoswarm is a cloud-like swarm of nanoscale robots, remotely controlled by a digitized human mind housed inside a Neural Projection Cabinet.

XenotypeDef.label: AI Nanoswarm
XenotypeDef.description: AI Nanoswarms are cloud-like swarms of nanoscale robots, remotely controlled by an AI construct to grant the AI a physical presense. Frequently deployed to manage and maintain an estate, ship or even small governments.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: AI Nanoswarms are cloud-like swarms of nanoscale robots, remotely controlled by an AI construct to grant the AI a physical presense.
